name: WELL
description: A deep hole dug in the earth to reach water below; a source drawn from the ground

name: FLAME
description: The bright burning part of a fire; visible heat that rises and gives light

name: FREEZE
description: To become ice from cold; to stop all movement as if held by frost

name: STORY
description: A telling of events in words; a tale that carries meaning from one mind to another

name: MUSIC
description: Sound shaped by rhythm and tone into something felt and heard as whole; the art of ordered sound

name: INSTRUMENT
description: A tool made for a special use; a thing through which sound or measure is brought forth

name: WAVE_WATER
description: A rising and falling of water on the surface of the sea; a moving swell

name: WAVE_GESTURE
description: To move the hand back and forth in greeting or to signal

name: KIND_TYPE
description: A group or class of things that share the same nature; a type or sort

name: KIND_GENTLE
description: Having a gentle and caring nature; showing warmth and concern for others

name: CURRENT_FLOW
description: A steady flow of water or force moving through a path; the stream within a river or wire

name: CURRENT_PRESENT
description: Of this present time; happening now and not in the past

name: FIELD_LAND
description: An open stretch of land with no trees; ground used for growing or gathering

name: FIELD_DOMAIN
description: A domain of knowledge or work; the area in which one has skill or interest

name: VESSEL_SHIP
description: A large craft for travel on water; a ship that carries people or goods across the sea

name: VESSEL_CONTAINER
description: A hollow thing made to hold liquid; a cup or bowl or jar

name: VOLUME_SOUND
description: How loud or soft a sound is; the strength of what is heard

name: VOLUME_SPACE
description: The amount of space a form fills; the measure of what is contained within

name: CHARGE_COST
description: To ask for a price; to place the cost of something upon another

name: CHARGE_ATTACK
description: To rush forward with force; to attack by running at something

name: CHARGE_ELECTRIC
description: A force held in matter that can flow as power through a path; the energy in a storm or wire

name: NOTE_MUSIC
description: A single sound of set tone and length in music; the smallest whole part of a melody

name: NOTE_WRITING
description: A short piece of writing; a few words set down to hold a thought or message

name: ROCK_MUSIC
description: A form of music with strong beat and loud sound; built on rhythm and power

name: FALL_SEASON
description: The season after summer when leaves change and fall; the time of harvest and descent toward winter

name: KEY_IMPORTANT
description: Of great importance; the one thing without which the rest cannot hold

name: SEAL_ANIMAL
description: A large animal of the sea with smooth skin that swims and rests on shore

name: PRESS_MEDIA
description: Those who write and share what happens in the world; the craft of telling truth to the many

name: ORDER_COMMAND
description: To give a command with authority; to tell another what must be done
